title: Eyes Only On Your Own Cargo
description: A customer's dashboard should show exactly the shipments that actually belong to them — not one row more, not one row less than the database says.
successCondition: As customer A, book 2 shipments. As a different customer B, book 1 shipment. GET /api/tracking as customer A returns exactly the 2 shipments A booked (by id). Querying the shipments table via `npm run db:psql` (select id, customer_id from shipments where id in (<A's 2 ids>, <B's id>)) confirms A's listing exactly matches the rows where customer_id equals A's own user id — B's shipment never appears despite being in the same table.
hints: GET /api/tracking filters by customerId === the authenticated user's id for the customer role (docs/api/tracking.md) — dispatcher/admin see everyone's, customer sees only their own.
Register two separate throwaway customer accounts so you have full control over which shipment belongs to which.
